subject: Partnership idea for VedicHour
body:
Hi [First name], I’m reaching out from VedicHour because [their work] seems aligned with reflective, grounded spirituality. We help people understand daily timing patterns without certainty claims: each report rates all 18 planetary hours using Swiss Ephemeris + Lahiri ayanamsa, then explains clearer and heavier windows in plain English. We’d like to offer you a free Pro account, a custom listener code ([PARTNERNAME]10), and a revenue share if it feels useful to your audience. No scripts required; we can keep it simple and transparent.

Your Life, Decoded Hour by Hour.

To stop hearing from us, reply unsubscribe; [Physical address]
linter_reason: Content aligns with timing awareness and calm reflection; no block or flag triggers.
